verdict: Spend rose sharply this week; leads did not follow. Here's why.
narrative: In the last 28 days, your Google Ads spend surged 124% over the prior week, but the additional budget produced zero additional leads, pushing your cost per lead up 41% to $249.51. The core issue is that your lead intake process isn't yet set up to convert increased ad traffic into booked jobs, which means scaling spend further right now would continue buying nothing. We're pausing the aggressive Google budget push until intake is confirmed and functioning. Separately, your Local Services Ads heating toggles — which should have been live September 1st — are being re-enabled immediately so you're covered heading into heating season. Expect a steadier, more efficient cost per lead next period as these two items are resolved.
